title: Dissector-side defects in consumers of Wireshark's wmem pools: twelve temporal, one spatial
note: Cases 0-12 are temporal; case 13 is the corpus's one SPATIAL row and its discriminating arm is sublet-chunks rather than sublet. Triage for the temporal rows is in the README; for the spatial row it is docs/ref/wireshark-spatial-defect-triage.md. Case 13 was measured 2026-10-05 on both the WM_CHUNKS=ON and WM_CHUNKS=OFF builds, with case 11 as a temporal regression control and the suite's negative control run and passed; results/20261005-qemu-spatial-case13-{ON,OFF}. That run REFUTED the completion predictions case 13 was filed with -- see its own README.
